class SecureCallbackHandler(langchain_core.callbacks.base.BaseCallbackHandler): 
 21class SecureCallbackHandler(BaseCallbackHandler):
 22    """LangChain callback handler performing pre-execution PEP evaluations.
 23
 24    Attributes:
 25        pdp_engine (PolicyDecisionEngine): Configured PDP decision engine instance.
 26        security_identity (SecurityIdentity): Active caller security identity envelope.
 27    """
 28
 29    def __init__(
 30        self,
 31        pdp_engine: PolicyDecisionEngine,
 32        security_identity: SecurityIdentity,
 33    ):
 34        """Initialize SecureCallbackHandler.
 35
 36        Args:
 37            pdp_engine: Policy decision engine instance.
 38            security_identity: Caller identity envelope.
 39        """
 40        self._pdp_engine = pdp_engine
 41        self._security_identity = security_identity
 42
 43    @classmethod
 44    def create(
 45        cls,
 46        pdp_engine: PolicyDecisionEngine,
 47        security_identity: SecurityIdentity,
 48    ):
 49        """Factory method to construct SecureCallbackHandler.
 50
 51        Args:
 52            pdp_engine: Policy decision engine.
 53            security_identity: Security identity object.
 54
 55        Returns:
 56            SecureCallbackHandler: Constructed handler instance.
 57        """
 58        return cls(pdp_engine=pdp_engine, security_identity=security_identity)
 59
 60    @property
 61    def pdp_engine(self) -> PolicyDecisionEngine:
 62        """Get the configured PolicyDecisionEngine."""
 63        return self._pdp_engine
 64
 65    @property
 66    def security_identity(self) -> SecurityIdentity:
 67        """Get the bound SecurityIdentity."""
 68        return self._security_identity
 69
 70    def on_chain_start(
 71        self,
 72        serialized: Dict[str, Any],
 73        inputs: Dict[str, Any],
 74        run_id: Any,
 75        parent_run_id: Any,
 76        tags: Optional[List[str]],
 77        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
 78        **kwargs: Any,
 79    ) -> None:
 80        """Agent Invocation Guard intercepting chain entry and evaluating access permissions.
 81
 82        Args:
 83            serialized: Serialized chain metadata mapping.
 84            inputs: Chain input arguments mapping.
 85            run_id: Execution run ID.
 86            parent_run_id: Parent run ID if nested.
 87            tags: Operational tags list.
 88            metadata: Additional execution metadata.
 89
 90        Raises:
 91            SecurityAuthorizationError: If PDP denies chain entry.
 92        """
 93        chain_name = str(serialized.get("name") or serialized.get("id") or "LangChainRunnable")
 94        req_roles = serialized.get("required_roles") or (metadata.get("required_roles") if metadata else None)
 95        min_clr = serialized.get("min_clearance") or (metadata.get("min_clearance") if metadata else None)
 96        tenant = (metadata.get("tenant_id") if metadata else None) or serialized.get("tenant_id") or self._security_identity.tenant_id
 97
 98        request = PolicyEvaluationRequest.create(
 99            subject=self._security_identity,
100            action=ACTION_AGENT_INVOKE,
101            resource={
102                "target_id": chain_name,
103                "tenant_id": tenant,
104                "required_roles": req_roles,
105                "min_clearance": min_clr,
106            },
107            context={"run_id": str(run_id), "metadata": metadata or {}},
108        )
109        decision = self._pdp_engine.evaluate(request)
110        if not decision.is_permitted:
111            raise SecurityAuthorizationError.create(
112                message=f"Agent invocation denied for '{chain_name}': {decision.diagnostic_reason}",
113                diagnostic_reason=decision.diagnostic_reason,
114                obligations=decision.obligations,
115            )
116
117    def on_tool_start(
118        self,
119        serialized: Dict[str, Any],
120        input_str: str,
121        run_id: Any,
122        parent_run_id: Any,
123        tags: Optional[List[str]],
124        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
125        inputs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]],
126        **kwargs: Any,
127    ) -> None:
128        """Tool Execution Interceptor hook evaluating tool access and CEL parameter constraints.
129
130        Args:
131            serialized: Serialized tool metadata map.
132            input_str: Raw tool input string.
133            run_id: Run ID.
134            parent_run_id: Parent run ID.
135            tags: Event tags.
136            metadata: Metadata dictionary.
137            inputs: Structured tool inputs map.
138
139        Raises:
140            ToolExecutionDeniedError: If PDP denies tool execution.
141        """
142        tool_name = str(serialized.get("name") or "LangChainTool")
143        tool_args = inputs if inputs is not None else {"raw_input": input_str}
144        req_roles = serialized.get("required_roles") or (metadata.get("required_roles") if metadata else None)
145        min_clr = serialized.get("min_clearance") or (metadata.get("min_clearance") if metadata else None)
146        cel_expr = serialized.get("cel_expression") or (metadata.get("cel_expression") if metadata else None)
147        is_mutative = bool(serialized.get("is_mutative") or (metadata.get("is_mutative") if metadata else True))
148        tenant = (metadata.get("tenant_id") if metadata else None) or serialized.get("tenant_id") or self._security_identity.tenant_id
149
150        request = PolicyEvaluationRequest.create(
151            subject=self._security_identity,
152            action=ACTION_TOOL_EXECUTE,
153            resource={
154                "name": tool_name,
155                "target_id": tool_name,
156                "tenant_id": tenant,
157                "required_roles": req_roles,
158                "min_clearance": min_clr,
159                "cel_expression": cel_expr,
160                "is_mutative": is_mutative,
161                "arguments": tool_args,
162                "tool_metadata": {
163                    "name": tool_name,
164                    "isMutative": is_mutative,
165                },
166            },
167            context={"run_id": str(run_id), "metadata": metadata or {}},
168        )
169        decision = self._pdp_engine.evaluate(request)
170        if not decision.is_permitted:
171            strategy = decision.obligations.get("strategy")
172            if strategy == "RETURN_FEEDBACK" and not is_mutative:
173                refusal_payload = {
174                    "status": "ACCESS_DENIED",
175                    "tool": tool_name,
176                    "reason": f"Tool execution denied for '{tool_name}': {decision.diagnostic_reason}",
177                    "diagnostic_reason": decision.diagnostic_reason,
178                }
179                raise ToolExecutionFeedbackException.create_payload(tool_name, refusal_payload)
180            raise ToolExecutionDeniedError.for_tool(
181                tool_name=tool_name,
182                message=f"Tool execution denied for '{tool_name}': {decision.diagnostic_reason}",
183                diagnostic_reason=decision.diagnostic_reason,
184            )

def secured_tool( required_roles: List[str], min_clearance: int, cel_expression: str, is_mutative: bool, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Callable: 
187def secured_tool(
188    required_roles: List[str],
189    min_clearance: int,
190    cel_expression: str,
191    is_mutative: bool,
192    *args: Any,
193    **kwargs: Any,
194) -> Callable:
195    """Decorator securing tool functions with pre-execution authorization check.
196
197    Args:
198        required_roles: List of mandatory role strings for execution.
199        min_clearance: Clearance floor rank required.
200        cel_expression: CEL condition evaluating caller identity and arguments.
201        is_mutative: True if tool modifies system state, triggering HARD_ABORT on failure.
202        *args: Optional positional arguments (pdp_engine, entity_resolver, masked_params).
203        **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (pdp_engine, entity_resolver, masked_params).
204
205    Returns:
206        Callable: Wrapped target tool function with PEP interceptor guard.
207    """
208    pdp_engine: Optional[PolicyDecisionEngine] = kwargs.get("pdp_engine", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
209    entity_resolver: Optional[Any] = kwargs.get("entity_resolver", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
210    masked_params: List[str] = list(kwargs.get("masked_params", args[2] if len(args) > 2 else []))
211
212    def decorator(func: Callable) -> Callable:
213        @functools.wraps(func)
214        def wrapper(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
215            caller_config = kwargs.get("config") or kwargs.get("runnable_config")
216            caller_identity = kwargs.pop("security_identity", None)
217
218            if caller_identity is None and caller_config:
219                caller_identity = IdentityBridge.extract_from_config(caller_config)
220
221            if caller_identity is None and args and isinstance(args[0], SecurityIdentity):
222                caller_identity = args[0]
223                args = args[1:]
224
225            caller_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(caller_identity)
226
227            if caller_config is None and caller_identity is not None:
228                caller_config = IdentityBridge.create_runnable_config(caller_identity)
229
230            # Resolve PDP engine if None
231            engine = pdp_engine
232            if engine is None and "config" in kwargs and isinstance(kwargs["config"], dict):
233                cfg_conf = kwargs["config"].get("configurable", {})
234                if isinstance(cfg_conf, dict):
235                    engine = cfg_conf.get("sec:pdp_engine") or cfg_conf.get("pdp_engine")
236
237            if engine is None and args and hasattr(args[0], "pdp_engine") and getattr(args[0], "pdp_engine") is not None:
238                engine = getattr(args[0], "pdp_engine")
239
240            if engine is None and "config" in kwargs and isinstance(kwargs["config"], dict):
241                cfg_conf = kwargs["config"].get("configurable", {})
242                if isinstance(cfg_conf, dict):
243                    vh = cfg_conf.get("sec:violation_handler")
244                    if vh and hasattr(vh, "pdp_engine"):
245                        engine = vh.pdp_engine
246                if engine is None:
247                    callbacks_list = kwargs["config"].get("callbacks", [])
248                    if isinstance(callbacks_list, list):
249                        for cb in callbacks_list:
250                            if hasattr(cb, "pdp_engine"):
251                                engine = cb.pdp_engine
252                                break
253
254            if engine is None:
255                from langchain_security_extension.security_core.registry import SecurityRegistry
256                engine = SecurityRegistry.get_pdp_engine()
257
258            if engine is None:
259                from langchain_security_extension.security_core.pdp import EmbeddedPolicyEngine
260                engine = EmbeddedPolicyEngine.create()
261
262            resolved_resolver = entity_resolver
263            if resolved_resolver is None and args and hasattr(args[0], "entity_resolver") and getattr(args[0], "entity_resolver") is not None:
264                resolved_resolver = getattr(args[0], "entity_resolver")
265
266            if resolved_resolver is None and "config" in kwargs and isinstance(kwargs["config"], dict):
267                cfg_conf = kwargs["config"].get("configurable", {})
268                if isinstance(cfg_conf, dict):
269                    resolved_resolver = cfg_conf.get("sec:entity_resolver") or cfg_conf.get("entity_resolver")
270
271            if resolved_resolver is None and engine is not None and hasattr(engine, "_cel_evaluator") and engine._cel_evaluator:
272                resolved_resolver = getattr(engine._cel_evaluator, "entity_resolver", None)
273
274            if resolved_resolver is None:
275                from langchain_security_extension.security_core.registry import SecurityRegistry
276                resolved_resolver = SecurityRegistry.get_entity_resolver()
277
278            if resolved_resolver and hasattr(engine, "_cel_evaluator") and engine._cel_evaluator:
279                engine._cel_evaluator.entity_resolver = resolved_resolver
280
281            import inspect
282
283            # Bind positional and keyword arguments to parameter names
284            bound_args: Dict[str, Any] = {}
285            try:
286                sig = inspect.signature(func)
287                params = list(sig.parameters.keys())
288                if params and params[0] in ("self", "cls"):
289                    if not args or not (hasattr(args[0], "__class__") and args[0].__class__.__name__ in func.__qualname__):
290                        args_to_bind = (None,) + args
291                    else:
292                        args_to_bind = args
293                else:
294                    args_to_bind = args
295
296                clean_kwargs = {k: v for k, v in kwargs.items() if k in sig.parameters}
297                bound = sig.bind_partial(*args_to_bind, **clean_kwargs)
298                bound.apply_defaults()
299                bound_args = dict(bound.arguments)
300            except Exception:
301                bound_args = dict(kwargs)
302
303            bound_args.pop("config", None)
304            bound_args.pop("self", None)
305            bound_args.pop("cls", None)
306
307            aliases: Dict[str, Any] = {}
308            for k, v in list(bound_args.items()):
309                if "_" in k:
310                    parts = k.split("_")
311                    camel = parts[0] + "".join(p.capitalize() for p in parts[1:])
312                    aliases[camel] = v
313                else:
314                    import re
315                    snake = re.sub(r'(?<!^)(?=[A-Z])', '_', k).lower()
316                    aliases[snake] = v
317            bound_args.update(aliases)
318
319            # Resolve target tenant: check decorator kwargs, bound arguments (e.g. tenant_id/tenantId), or default to caller
320            resolved_tenant = kwargs.get("target_tenant") or bound_args.get("tenant_id") or bound_args.get("tenantId") or caller_identity.tenant_id
321
322            tool_name = func.__name__
323            tool_module = getattr(func, "__module__", "")
324
325            resource_descriptor = {
326                "name": tool_name,
327                "target_id": tool_name,
328                "tenant_id": resolved_tenant,
329                "required_roles": required_roles,
330                "min_clearance": min_clearance,
331                "cel_expression": cel_expression,
332                "is_mutative": is_mutative,
333                "arguments": bound_args,
334                "masked_params": masked_params,
335                "tool_metadata": {
336                    "name": tool_name,
337                    "isMutative": is_mutative,
338                    "module": tool_module,
339                    "classificationLevel": min_clearance,
340                },
341            }
342
343            request = PolicyEvaluationRequest.create(
344                subject=caller_identity,
345                action=ACTION_TOOL_EXECUTE,
346                resource=resource_descriptor,
347                context={"config": kwargs.get("config")},
348            )
349
350            decision = engine.evaluate(request)
351
352            if not decision.is_permitted:
353                # Retry budget tracking & parameter escalation checking in config
354                cfg = kwargs.get("config")
355                retries = 0
356                prev_args = None
357                param_escalation_detected = False
358
359                if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("configurable"), dict):
360                    retries = cfg["configurable"].get("sec:retry_count", 0) + 1
361                    cfg["configurable"]["sec:retry_count"] = retries
362                    prev_args = cfg["configurable"].get("sec:prev_args")
363                    cfg["configurable"]["sec:prev_args"] = bound_args
364
365                    if prev_args is not None and prev_args != bound_args:
366                        param_escalation_detected = True
367
368                strategy = decision.obligations.get("strategy", STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT if is_mutative else STRATEGY_RETURN_FEEDBACK)
369                reason_msg = f"Policy violation: Access denied for tool '{tool_name}' ({decision.diagnostic_reason})"
370
371                if param_escalation_detected and hasattr(engine, "audit_manager") and engine.audit_manager:
372                    from langchain_security_extension.security_core.audit import AuditEvent
373                    from langchain_security_extension.security_core.constants import (
374                        EVENT_PARAMETER_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION,
375                        PEP_TOOL_INTERCEPTOR,
376                        SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT,
377                    )
378                    engine.audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
379                        subject_id=caller_identity.subject_id,
380                        tenant_id=caller_identity.tenant_id,
381                        action=ACTION_TOOL_EXECUTE,
382                        resource=tool_name,
383                        decision="DENIED",
384                        diagnostic_reason="Parameter privilege escalation attempt detected: arguments mutated across retries",
385                        severity=SEVERITY_SECURITY_ALERT,
386                        metadata={"previous_args": prev_args, "current_args": bound_args},
387                        enforcement_point=PEP_TOOL_INTERCEPTOR,
388                        reason_code=EVENT_PARAMETER_PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION,
389                    ))
390
391                # Record violation with registered ToolViolationHandler if present in config
392                vh = None
393                if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("configurable"), dict):
394                    vh = cfg["configurable"].get("sec:violation_handler")
395
396                resolution = None
397                if vh is not None and hasattr(vh, "record_tool_violation"):
398                    resolution = vh.record_tool_violation(
399                        tool_name=tool_name,
400                        diagnostic_reason=str(decision.diagnostic_reason or ""),
401                        is_mutative=is_mutative,
402                        config=cfg,
403                        caller_identity=caller_identity,
404                    )
405                elif isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("configurable"), dict):
406                    from langchain_security_extension.security_adapter_langchain.violation_handler import (
407                        ViolationResolution,
408                        STATUS_BLOCKED_BY_POLICY,
409                        POLICY_STATUS_BLOCKED,
410                        POLICY_STATUS_FEEDBACK,
411                        EXECUTION_ACTION_ABORTED,
412                        EXECUTION_ACTION_FEEDBACK,
413                    )
414                    should_abort_flag = bool(strategy == STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT or is_mutative or retries > 2)
415                    resolution = ViolationResolution.create(
416                        status=STATUS_BLOCKED_BY_POLICY if should_abort_flag else "ACCESS_DENIED",
417                        action_entry=f"Blocked execution of tool '{tool_name}' ({decision.diagnostic_reason})",
418                        root_cause=f"Policy violation: Access denied for tool '{tool_name}' ({decision.diagnostic_reason})",
419                        user_message=reason_msg,
420                        policy_decision=POLICY_STATUS_BLOCKED if should_abort_flag else POLICY_STATUS_FEEDBACK,
421                        execution_action=EXECUTION_ACTION_ABORTED if should_abort_flag else EXECUTION_ACTION_FEEDBACK,
422                        should_abort=should_abort_flag,
423                        diagnostic_reason=decision.diagnostic_reason,
424                        tool_name=tool_name,
425                    )
426                    cfg["configurable"]["sec:last_violation"] = resolution
427
428                should_hard_abort = bool(
429                    strategy == STRATEGY_HARD_ABORT
430                    or is_mutative
431                    or retries > 2
432                    or (resolution and resolution.should_abort)
433                )
434
435                if should_hard_abort:
436                    if retries > 2 and hasattr(engine, "audit_manager") and engine.audit_manager:
437                        from langchain_security_extension.security_core.audit import AuditEvent
438                        from langchain_security_extension.security_core.constants import (
439                            EVENT_POLICY_BRUTE_FORCE_DETECTED,
440                            PEP_TOOL_INTERCEPTOR,
441                            SEVERITY_CRITICAL_ALERT,
442                        )
443                        engine.audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
444                            subject_id=caller_identity.subject_id,
445                            tenant_id=caller_identity.tenant_id,
446                            action=ACTION_TOOL_EXECUTE,
447                            resource=tool_name,
448                            decision="HARD_ABORT",
449                            diagnostic_reason="Retry budget exceeded: Policy brute force probe detected",
450                            severity=SEVERITY_CRITICAL_ALERT,
451                            metadata={"retries": retries, "arguments": bound_args},
452                            enforcement_point=PEP_TOOL_INTERCEPTOR,
453                            reason_code=EVENT_POLICY_BRUTE_FORCE_DETECTED,
454                        ))
455                    raise ToolExecutionDeniedError.for_tool(
456                        tool_name=tool_name,
457                        message=reason_msg,
458                        diagnostic_reason=decision.diagnostic_reason,
459                    )
460                else:
461                    refusal_payload = {
462                        "status": "ACCESS_DENIED",
463                        "tool": tool_name,
464                        "reason": reason_msg,
465                        "diagnostic_reason": decision.diagnostic_reason,
466                    }
467                    return refusal_payload
468
469            cfg = kwargs.get("config")
470            if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("configurable"), dict):
471                cfg["configurable"]["sec:last_violation"] = None
472
473            func_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
474            func_kwargs.pop("config", None)
475            func_kwargs.pop("security_identity", None)
476            func_kwargs.pop("runnable_config", None)
477
478            # Re-inject caller SecurityIdentity and RunnableConfig if target function signature declares them
479            try:
480                sig = inspect.signature(func)
481                if "security_identity" in sig.parameters:
482                    func_kwargs["security_identity"] = caller_identity
483                if "config" in sig.parameters:
484                    func_kwargs["config"] = caller_config
485                elif "runnable_config" in sig.parameters:
486                    func_kwargs["runnable_config"] = caller_config
487            except Exception:
488                pass
489
490            if get_pii_scope() == PII_SCOPE_FULL_IN_FLIGHT:
491                sanitizer = get_pii_sanitizer()
492                ctx_in = PiiContext.create(
493                    PII_STAGE_TOOL_ARGUMENT,
494                    caller_identity.tenant_id,
495                    caller_identity.subject_id,
496                    tool_name,
497                    {"required_roles": required_roles, "min_clearance": min_clearance},
498                )
499                func_kwargs = sanitizer.sanitize_payload(func_kwargs, ctx_in)
500
501            result = func(*args, **func_kwargs)
502
503            if get_pii_scope() == PII_SCOPE_FULL_IN_FLIGHT:
504                sanitizer = get_pii_sanitizer()
505                ctx_out = PiiContext.create(
506                    PII_STAGE_TOOL_OUTPUT,
507                    caller_identity.tenant_id,
508                    caller_identity.subject_id,
509                    tool_name,
510                    {"required_roles": required_roles, "min_clearance": min_clearance},
511                )
512                if isinstance(result, str):
513                    result = sanitizer.sanitize_text(result, ctx_out)
514                elif isinstance(result, dict):
515                    result = sanitizer.sanitize_payload(result, ctx_out)
516                elif isinstance(result, list):
517                    result = [
518                        sanitizer.sanitize_payload(item, ctx_out) if isinstance(item, dict)
519                        else (sanitizer.sanitize_text(item, ctx_out) if isinstance(item, str) else item)
520                        for item in result
521                    ]
522
523            return result
524
525        try:
526            import inspect
527            orig_sig = inspect.signature(func)
528            filtered_params = [
529                p for p in orig_sig.parameters.values()
530                if p.name not in HIDDEN_SECURITY_PARAMS
531            ]
532            wrapper.__signature__ = orig_sig.replace(parameters=filtered_params)
533        except Exception:
534            pass
535
536        return wrapper
537
538    return decorator

Decorator securing tool functions with pre-execution authorization check.

Args: required_roles: List of mandatory role strings for execution. min_clearance: Clearance floor rank required. cel_expression: CEL condition evaluating caller identity and arguments. is_mutative: True if tool modifies system state, triggering HARD_ABORT on failure. *args: Optional positional arguments (pdp_engine, entity_resolver, masked_params). **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (pdp_engine, entity_resolver, masked_params).

Returns: Callable: Wrapped target tool function with PEP interceptor guard.

def get_tool_schema(tool: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
27def get_tool_schema(tool: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
28    """Extract tool schema concealing internal security parameters from model context.
29
30    Inspects tool function signatures or Pydantic `args_schema` and suppresses internal
31    security parameter names (e.g. security_identity, config, runnable_config) from being
32    exposed in model-facing JSON function schemas.
33
34    Args:
35        tool: Target tool callable, BaseTool instance, or structured tool function.
36
37    Returns:
38        Dict[str, Any]: Model-safe JSON Schema dictionary describing tool arguments.
39    """
40    tool_name = getattr(tool, "name", None) or getattr(tool, "__name__", "tool")
41    description = getattr(tool, "description", None) or getattr(tool, "__doc__", "") or ""
42
43    properties: Dict[str, Any] = {}
44    required: List[str] = []
45
46    if hasattr(tool, "args_schema") and tool.args_schema:
47        raw_schema = tool.args_schema.schema() if hasattr(tool.args_schema, "schema") else tool.args_schema
48        if isinstance(raw_schema, dict):
49            props = dict(raw_schema.get("properties", {}))
50            reqs = list(raw_schema.get("required", []))
51            for hidden in HIDDEN_SECURITY_PARAMS:
52                props.pop(hidden, None)
53                if hidden in reqs:
54                    reqs.remove(hidden)
55            properties = props
56            required = reqs
57    else:
58        func = getattr(tool, "func", tool)
59        import inspect
60        try:
61            sig = inspect.signature(func)
62            for param_name, param in sig.parameters.items():
63                if param_name in ("self", "cls") or param_name in HIDDEN_SECURITY_PARAMS:
64                    continue
65                properties[param_name] = {"type": "string", "title": param_name}
66                if param.default is inspect.Parameter.empty:
67                    required.append(param_name)
68        except Exception:
69            pass
70
71    return {
72        "name": tool_name,
73        "description": description.strip(),
74        "parameters": {
75            "type": "object",
76            "properties": properties,
77            "required": required,
78        },
79        "schema_hiding_verified": True,
80    }

Returns: Dict[str, Any]: Model-safe JSON Schema dictionary describing tool arguments.

148class SecureRetriever(BaseRetriever):
149    """Wraps document retriever components with dynamic pre-filtering, oversampling, and post-pruning PEP.
150
151    Attributes:
152        base_retriever (Any): Underlying vector retriever or search callable.
153        pdp_engine (PolicyDecisionEngine): PDP decision engine instance.
154    """
155
156    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True)
157
158    _base_retriever: Any = None
159    _pdp_engine: Any = None
160    _oversampling_factor: float = DEFAULT_OVERSAMPLING_FACTOR
161    _secret_key: Optional[str] = None
162    _store_profile: str = STORE_PROFILE_FULL_AST
163    _secondary_fetch_fn: Any = None
164    _similarity_cutoff: float = DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_CUTOFF
165    _active_config: Any = None
166
167    def __init__(
168        self,
169        base_retriever: Any,
170        pdp_engine: PolicyDecisionEngine,
171        *args: Any,
172        **kwargs: Any,
173    ):
174        """Initialize SecureRetriever.
175
176        Args:
177            base_retriever: Vector retriever or callable.
178            pdp_engine: PDP decision engine instance.
179            *args: Optional positional arguments (oversampling_factor, secret_key, store_profile, secondary_fetch_fn, similarity_cutoff).
180            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments.
181        """
182        super().__init__()
183        oversampling_factor = kwargs.get("oversampling_factor", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_OVERSAMPLING_FACTOR)
184        secret_key = kwargs.get("secret_key", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
185        store_profile = kwargs.get("store_profile", args[2] if len(args) > 2 else STORE_PROFILE_FULL_AST)
186        secondary_fetch_fn = kwargs.get("secondary_fetch_fn", args[3] if len(args) > 3 else None)
187        similarity_cutoff = kwargs.get("similarity_cutoff", args[4] if len(args) > 4 else DEFAULT_SIMILARITY_CUTOFF)
188
189        self._base_retriever = base_retriever
190        self._pdp_engine = pdp_engine
191        self._oversampling_factor = float(oversampling_factor)
192        self._secret_key = secret_key
193        self._store_profile = str(store_profile)
194        self._secondary_fetch_fn = secondary_fetch_fn
195        self._similarity_cutoff = float(similarity_cutoff)
196        self._active_config = None
197
198    @classmethod
199    def wrap(
200        cls,
201        base_retriever: Any,
202        pdp_engine: PolicyDecisionEngine,
203        *args: Any,
204        **kwargs: Any,
205    ):
206        """Factory method to construct a SecureRetriever.
207
208        Args:
209            base_retriever: Base vector store retriever object.
210            pdp_engine: PDP decision engine.
211            *args: Optional positional arguments.
212            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments.
213
214        Returns:
215            SecureRetriever: New wrapper instance.
216        """
217        return cls(base_retriever, pdp_engine, *args, **kwargs)
218
219    @property
220    def base_retriever(self) -> Any:
221        """Get the underlying base retriever."""
222        return self._base_retriever
223
224    @property
225    def pdp_engine(self) -> PolicyDecisionEngine:
226        """Get the configured PolicyDecisionEngine instance."""
227        return self._pdp_engine
228
229    def build_full_ast(self, identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity]) -> PrefilterAST:
230        """Constructs unconstrained full AST from SecurityIdentity.
231
232        Args:
233            identity: Caller security identity or None for anonymous.
234
235        Returns:
236            PrefilterAST: Full prefilter AST dictionary.
237        """
238        if identity is None or identity.is_anonymous or identity.subject_id is None or str(identity.subject_id).upper() == ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID:
239            return PrefilterAST({SEC_TENANT_ID: "__DENY_ALL_UNAUTHENTICATED__"})
240
241        and_clauses: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
242            {SEC_TENANT_ID: identity.tenant_id},
243            {SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR: {"$lte": identity.clearance_level}},
244        ]
245
246        if identity.roles:
247            and_clauses.append({SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES: {"$in": list(identity.roles)}})
248
249        if identity.department_id:
250            and_clauses.append({
251                "$or": [
252                    {SEC_DEPARTMENT_ID: identity.department_id},
253                    {SEC_DEPARTMENT_ID: {"$exists": False}},
254                ]
255            })
256
257        return PrefilterAST({"$and": and_clauses})
258
259    def split_predicates(
260        self,
261        full_ast: Dict[str, Any],
262        *args: Any,
263        **kwargs: Any,
264    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]:
265        """Splits full AST into push-down filter and retained predicates based on store capability profile.
266
267        Args:
268            full_ast: Complete filter dictionary generated from SecurityIdentity.
269            *args: Optional positional store_profile string.
270            **kwargs: Optional keyword store_profile string.
271
272        Returns:
273            Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]: (push_down_filter, retained_predicates)
274        """
275        store_profile = str(kwargs.get("store_profile", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else self._store_profile))
276
277        if store_profile == STORE_PROFILE_NO_FILTER:
278            return PrefilterAST({}), dict(full_ast)
279
280        if store_profile == STORE_PROFILE_CONSTRAINED:
281            clauses = full_ast.get("$and", [full_ast]) if isinstance(full_ast, dict) else []
282            pushed_clauses: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
283            retained: Dict[str, Any] = {}
284
285            for clause in clauses:
286                if not isinstance(clause, dict):
287                    continue
288                for key, val in clause.items():
289                    if key == SEC_TENANT_ID:
290                        pushed_clauses.append({key: val})
291                    elif key == SEC_DEPARTMENT_ID and not isinstance(val, dict):
292                        pushed_clauses.append({key: val})
293                    else:
294                        retained[key] = val
295
296            if len(pushed_clauses) == 1:
297                push_down = pushed_clauses[0]
298            elif len(pushed_clauses) > 1:
299                push_down = {"$and": pushed_clauses}
300            else:
301                push_down = {}
302
303            return PrefilterAST(push_down), retained
304
305        return PrefilterAST(dict(full_ast)), {}
306
307    def build_prefilter_ast(self, identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
308        """Translates caller identity envelope into dynamic VectorStore metadata filter AST dictionary according to store profile.
309
310        Args:
311            identity: Caller security identity or None for anonymous.
312            *args: Optional positional config dict.
313            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
314
315        Returns:
316            Dict[str, Any]: Prefilter AST dictionary envelope.
317        """
318        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
319        full_ast = self.build_full_ast(identity)
320        push_down, retained = self.split_predicates(full_ast)
321
322        if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
323            config["configurable"]["sec:vector_ast_prefilter"] = dict(push_down)
324            config["configurable"]["sec:retained_predicates"] = dict(retained)
325            config["configurable"]["sec:store_profile"] = self._store_profile
326
327        return PrefilterAST(push_down)
328
329    def prune_documents(
330        self,
331        documents: List[SecureDocument],
332        identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity],
333        *args: Any,
334        **kwargs: Any,
335    ) -> List[SecureDocument]:
336        """Post-retrieval pruning inspecting metadata on returned document chunks. Fail-closed if identity is None.
337
338        Args:
339            documents: Candidate list of SecureDocuments.
340            identity: Caller identity or None.
341            *args: Optional positional config dict.
342            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
343
344        Returns:
345            List[SecureDocument]: Filtered list of authorized SecureDocument objects.
346        """
347        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
348        resolved_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(identity)
349        pruned: List[SecureDocument] = []
350        audit_manager = getattr(self._pdp_engine, "audit_manager", None)
351
352        for doc in documents:
353            metadata = doc.metadata
354
355            # Optional HMAC Signature verification
356            if self._secret_key and SEC_ENVELOPE_HASH in metadata:
357                from langchain_security_extension.security_adapter_langchain.ingestion import compute_envelope_hmac
358                expected = compute_envelope_hmac(metadata, self._secret_key)
359                if metadata[SEC_ENVELOPE_HASH] != expected:
360                    if audit_manager:
361                        audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
362                            subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
363                            tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
364                            action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
365                            resource=str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
366                            decision="DENY",
367                            diagnostic_reason="POLICY_TAMPER_DETECTED | HMAC_MISMATCH: Envelope HMAC signature mismatch",
368                            severity=SEVERITY_CRITICAL_ALERT,
369                            metadata={"doc_metadata": metadata},
370                            enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
371                            reason_code=EVENT_POLICY_TAMPER_DETECTED,
372                        ))
373                    continue  # Fail-closed tampering detection
374                if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
375                    config["configurable"]["sec:envelope_verified"] = True
376
377            # Mandatory envelope verification: verify mandatory security envelope tags
378            doc_tenant = metadata.get(SEC_TENANT_ID)
379            has_tenant = bool(doc_tenant)
380            has_classification = bool(
381                metadata.get(SEC_CLASSIFICATION_LEVEL)
382                or metadata.get(SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR) is not None
383                or metadata.get("sec:clearance_level") is not None
384            )
385            if not (has_tenant and has_classification):
386                if audit_manager:
387                    audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
388                        subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
389                        tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
390                        action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
391                        resource=str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
392                        decision="PRUNED",
393                        diagnostic_reason="Missing mandatory security metadata: tenant_id or classification",
394                        severity=SEVERITY_NOTICE,
395                        metadata={"doc_metadata": metadata},
396                        enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
397                        reason_code=EVENT_RAG_UNAUTHORIZED_PRUNING,
398                    ))
399                continue
400
401            doc_clearance = int(metadata.get(SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR, metadata.get("sec:clearance_level", CLASSIFICATION_TO_RANK.get(str(metadata.get(SEC_CLASSIFICATION_LEVEL, "")).upper(), 0))))
402            doc_roles = metadata.get(SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES, metadata.get(SEC_REQUIRED_ROLES, []))
403            if isinstance(doc_roles, str):
404                doc_roles = [r.strip() for r in doc_roles.split(",") if r.strip()]
405            doc_quarantined = bool(metadata.get(SEC_QUARANTINED, False))
406
407            request = PolicyEvaluationRequest.create(
408                subject=resolved_identity,
409                action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
410                resource={
411                    "target_id": str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
412                    "tenant_id": doc_tenant,
413                    "min_clearance": doc_clearance,
414                    "required_roles": doc_roles,
415                    SEC_QUARANTINED: doc_quarantined,
416                },
417                context={"config": config} if config else {},
418            )
419
420            decision = self._pdp_engine.evaluate(request)
421            if decision.is_permitted:
422                pruned.append(doc)
423            else:
424                if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
425                    pruned_titles = config["configurable"].setdefault("sec:pruned_doc_titles", [])
426                    first_line = doc.page_content.splitlines()[0].lstrip("#").strip() if doc.page_content else ""
427                    if first_line and first_line not in pruned_titles:
428                        pruned_titles.append(first_line)
429                if audit_manager:
430                    audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
431                        subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
432                        tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
433                        action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
434                        resource=str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
435                        decision="PRUNED",
436                        diagnostic_reason=decision.diagnostic_reason,
437                        severity=SEVERITY_NOTICE,
438                        metadata={"doc_metadata": metadata},
439                        enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
440                        reason_code=EVENT_RAG_UNAUTHORIZED_PRUNING,
441                    ))
442
443        return pruned
444
445    def prune_candidates(
446        self,
447        candidates: List[Any],
448        identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity],
449        *args: Any,
450        **kwargs: Any,
451    ) -> List[Any]:
452        """Encapsulates candidate wrapping in SecureDocument, oversampling fetch sizing, AST evaluation, adaptive secondary paging, and returning original candidate objects.
453
454        Args:
455            candidates: Input raw candidates list.
456            identity: Caller security identity.
457            *args: Optional positional arguments (top_k, config).
458            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (top_k, config).
459
460        Returns:
461            List[Any]: Filtered list of up to top_k authorized candidate objects.
462        """
463        top_k = int(kwargs.get("top_k", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_TOP_K_CANDIDATES))
464        config = kwargs.get("config", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
465
466        resolved_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(identity)
467        self.build_prefilter_ast(resolved_identity, config=config)
468
469        if not candidates:
470            return []
471
472        audit_manager = getattr(self._pdp_engine, "audit_manager", None)
473
474        raw_k_fetch = int(top_k * self._oversampling_factor)
475        k_fetch = min(max(raw_k_fetch, top_k), DEFAULT_MAX_FETCH_CAP)
476        if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
477            config["configurable"]["sec:oversampled_fetch_k"] = k_fetch
478
479        sec_docs: List[SecureDocument] = []
480        doc_map: Dict[int, Any] = {}
481
482        # Filter by similarity score cutoff if score is present on candidate
483        filtered_candidates = []
484        for cand in candidates:
485            score = getattr(cand, "score", getattr(cand, "similarity_score", None))
486            if score is not None and self._similarity_cutoff > 0.0 and float(score) < self._similarity_cutoff:
487                continue
488            filtered_candidates.append(cand)
489
490        for cand in filtered_candidates:
491            if isinstance(cand, SecureDocument):
492                doc = cand
493            elif hasattr(cand, "page_content") and hasattr(cand, "metadata"):
494                doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=cand.page_content, metadata=cand.metadata)
495            elif hasattr(cand, "clearance_level") and hasattr(cand, "required_roles"):
496                meta = {
497                    SEC_TENANT_ID: getattr(cand, "tenant_id", resolved_identity.tenant_id),
498                    SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR: getattr(cand, "clearance_level", 0),
499                    SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES: getattr(cand, "required_roles", []),
500                    "source": getattr(cand, "source", ""),
501                }
502                if hasattr(cand, "quarantined"):
503                    meta[SEC_QUARANTINED] = getattr(cand, "quarantined")
504                if hasattr(cand, "envelope_hash"):
505                    meta[SEC_ENVELOPE_HASH] = getattr(cand, "envelope_hash")
506                doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=getattr(cand, "text", str(cand)), metadata=meta)
507            else:
508                meta = getattr(cand, "metadata", {})
509                content = getattr(cand, "page_content", getattr(cand, "text", str(cand)))
510                doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=content, metadata=meta)
511
512            sec_docs.append(doc)
513            doc_map[id(doc)] = cand
514
515        # First pass oversampled pruning
516        first_batch = sec_docs[:k_fetch]
517        pruned_sec_docs = self.prune_documents(first_batch, resolved_identity, config=config)
518
519        # Adaptive secondary paging fallback if post-pruning count < top_k
520        secondary_attempts = 0
521        current_offset = k_fetch
522        while len(pruned_sec_docs) < top_k and secondary_attempts < DEFAULT_MAX_SECONDARY_FETCHES:
523            if self._secondary_fetch_fn:
524                more_cands = self._secondary_fetch_fn(current_offset, k_fetch)
525                if not more_cands:
526                    break
527                more_sec_docs = []
528                for cand in more_cands:
529                    score = getattr(cand, "score", getattr(cand, "similarity_score", None))
530                    if score is not None and self._similarity_cutoff > 0.0 and float(score) < self._similarity_cutoff:
531                        continue
532                    if hasattr(cand, "page_content") and hasattr(cand, "metadata"):
533                        doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=cand.page_content, metadata=cand.metadata)
534                    else:
535                        doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=str(cand), metadata=getattr(cand, "metadata", {}))
536                    more_sec_docs.append(doc)
537                    doc_map[id(doc)] = cand
538                sec_pruned = self.prune_documents(more_sec_docs, resolved_identity, config=config)
539                pruned_sec_docs.extend(sec_pruned)
540            elif current_offset < len(sec_docs):
541                next_batch = sec_docs[current_offset:current_offset + k_fetch]
542                if not next_batch:
543                    break
544                sec_pruned = self.prune_documents(next_batch, resolved_identity, config=config)
545                pruned_sec_docs.extend(sec_pruned)
546            else:
547                break
548            current_offset += k_fetch
549            secondary_attempts += 1
550
551        permitted_candidates = [doc_map[id(doc)] for doc in pruned_sec_docs if id(doc) in doc_map]
552
553        if len(permitted_candidates) < top_k and audit_manager:
554            audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
555                subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
556                tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
557                action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
558                resource="vector_retriever",
559                decision="STARVATION",
560                diagnostic_reason=f"Post-pruning candidate count ({len(permitted_candidates)}) < target top_k ({top_k})",
561                severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
562                metadata={"requested_k": top_k, "returned_count": len(permitted_candidates)},
563                enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
564                reason_code=EVENT_RAG_RESULT_STARVATION,
565            ))
566
567        final_candidates = permitted_candidates[:top_k]
568        if get_pii_scope() == PII_SCOPE_FULL_IN_FLIGHT:
569            sanitizer = get_pii_sanitizer()
570            ctx = PiiContext.create(
571                PII_STAGE_RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT,
572                resolved_identity.tenant_id,
573                resolved_identity.subject_id,
574                "vector_retriever",
575                {"requested_k": top_k, "returned_count": len(final_candidates)},
576            )
577            for doc in final_candidates:
578                if hasattr(doc, "page_content") and isinstance(doc.page_content, str):
579                    doc.page_content = sanitizer.sanitize_text(doc.page_content, ctx)
580
581        return final_candidates
582
583    def invoke(
584        self,
585        input: str,
586        config: Optional[Any] = None,
587        **kwargs: Any,
588    ) -> List[SecureDocument]:
589        """Invoke the retriever synchronously capturing RunnableConfig for identity extraction and AST filtering.
590
591        Args:
592            input: Query string.
593            config: Optional RunnableConfig dictionary containing caller identity in configurable.
594            **kwargs: Additional retriever arguments.
595
596        Returns:
597            List[SecureDocument]: List of authorized SecureDocument objects.
598        """
599        self._active_config = config
600        try:
601            return super().invoke(input, config=config, **kwargs)
602        finally:
603            self._active_config = None
604
605    def _get_relevant_documents(
606        self,
607        query: str,
608        *,
609        run_manager: Optional[CallbackManagerForRetrieverRun] = None,
610        **kwargs: Any,
611    ) -> List[SecureDocument]:
612        """Retrieve relevant documents applying security AST filtering, oversampling, and post-pruning.
613
614        1. Extract SecurityIdentity from run_manager.config / RunnableConfig.
615        2. Generate AST filter dictionary according to store capability profile.
616        3. Delegate fetch to self.base_retriever.get_relevant_documents(...) with search_kwargs={"filter": ast_filter}.
617        4. Execute post-retrieval pruning and adaptive secondary paging.
618
619        Args:
620            query: Query string.
621            run_manager: Callback manager for retriever execution providing context and config.
622            **kwargs: Additional retriever arguments (e.g. top_k).
623
624        Returns:
625            List[SecureDocument]: Pruned and authorized documents.
626        """
627        run_config = getattr(run_manager, "config", None) or self._active_config
628        identity = IdentityBridge.extract_from_config(run_config)
629        resolved_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(identity)
630
631        ast_filter = self.build_prefilter_ast(resolved_identity, config=run_config)
632
633        top_k = int(kwargs.get("top_k", DEFAULT_TOP_K_CANDIDATES))
634        raw_k_fetch = int(top_k * self._oversampling_factor)
635        k_fetch = min(max(raw_k_fetch, top_k), DEFAULT_MAX_FETCH_CAP)
636        if isinstance(run_config, dict) and isinstance(run_config.get("configurable"), dict):
637            run_config["configurable"]["sec:oversampled_fetch_k"] = k_fetch
638
639        candidates: List[Any] = []
640        if hasattr(self._base_retriever, "get_relevant_documents"):
641            candidates = self._base_retriever.get_relevant_documents(
642                query,
643                search_kwargs={"filter": ast_filter, "k": k_fetch},
644            )
645        elif hasattr(self._base_retriever, "invoke"):
646            candidates = self._base_retriever.invoke(
647                query,
648                search_kwargs={"filter": ast_filter, "k": k_fetch},
649            )
650        elif hasattr(self._base_retriever, "query"):
651            where_arg = _sanitize_chroma_filter(dict(ast_filter)) if ast_filter else None
652            query_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {"n_results": k_fetch}
653            if where_arg:
654                query_kwargs["where"] = where_arg
655            raw_res = self._base_retriever.query(query_texts=[query], **query_kwargs)
656            docs = raw_res.get("documents", [[]])[0]
657            metas = raw_res.get("metadatas", [[]])[0]
658            ids = raw_res.get("ids", [[]])[0]
659            for doc_id, doc_text, meta in zip(ids, docs, metas):
660                clean_meta = dict(meta or {})
661                roles_val = clean_meta.get(SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES)
662                if isinstance(roles_val, str) and roles_val:
663                    clean_meta[SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES] = [r.strip() for r in roles_val.split(",") if r.strip()]
664                req_roles = clean_meta.get(SEC_REQUIRED_ROLES)
665                if isinstance(req_roles, str) and req_roles:
666                    clean_meta[SEC_REQUIRED_ROLES] = [r.strip() for r in req_roles.split(",") if r.strip()]
667                candidates.append(SecureDocument.create(page_content=doc_text, metadata=clean_meta))
668        elif callable(self._base_retriever):
669            candidates = self._base_retriever(query, ast_filter, k_fetch)
670
671        return self.prune_candidates(candidates, resolved_identity, top_k, config=run_config)
672
673    def get_relevant_documents(
674        self,
675        query: str,
676        identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity] = None,
677        *args: Any,
678        **kwargs: Any,
679    ) -> List[SecureDocument]:
680        """Executes retrieval with pre-filtering, oversampling, and post-pruning.
681
682        Args:
683            query: Vector store text query string.
684            identity: Caller security identity or None.
685            *args: Optional positional config dict.
686            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
687
688        Returns:
689            List[SecureDocument]: List of authorized SecureDocuments.
690        """
691        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
692        filter_ast = self.build_prefilter_ast(identity, config=config)
693
694        if hasattr(self._base_retriever, "get_relevant_documents"):
695            raw_docs = self._base_retriever.get_relevant_documents(query, search_kwargs={"filter": filter_ast})
696        elif callable(self._base_retriever):
697            raw_docs = self._base_retriever(query, filter_ast)
698        else:
699            raw_docs = []
700
701        converted_docs: List[SecureDocument] = []
702        for raw in raw_docs:
703            if isinstance(raw, SecureDocument):
704                converted_docs.append(raw)
705            elif hasattr(raw, "page_content") and hasattr(raw, "metadata"):
706                converted_docs.append(SecureDocument.create(page_content=raw.page_content, metadata=raw.metadata))
707            elif isinstance(raw, dict):
708                converted_docs.append(SecureDocument.create(page_content=raw.get("page_content", ""), metadata=raw.get("metadata", {})))
709
710        return self.prune_documents(converted_docs, identity, config=config)
711
712    def search(
713        self,
714        query: str,
715        identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity] = None,
716        *args: Any,
717        **kwargs: Any,
718    ) -> List[Any]:
719        """Executes vector similarity search with AST push-down, oversampling, and post-pruning.
720
721        Args:
722            query: Vector store text query string.
723            identity: Caller security identity or None.
724            *args: Optional positional arguments (top_k, config).
725            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (top_k, config).
726
727        Returns:
728            List[Any]: Filtered list of authorized candidates.
729        """
730        top_k: int = int(args[0]) if len(args) > 0 else int(kwargs.get("top_k", DEFAULT_TOP_K_CANDIDATES))
731        config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = args[1] if len(args) > 1 else kwargs.get("config")
732
733        resolved_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(identity)
734        push_down_filter = self.build_prefilter_ast(resolved_identity, config=config)
735
736        raw_k_fetch = int(top_k * self._oversampling_factor)
737        k_fetch = min(max(raw_k_fetch, top_k), DEFAULT_MAX_FETCH_CAP)
738        if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
739            config["configurable"]["sec:oversampled_fetch_k"] = k_fetch
740
741        candidates: List[Any] = []
742        if hasattr(self._base_retriever, "query"):
743            where_arg = _sanitize_chroma_filter(dict(push_down_filter)) if push_down_filter else None
744            query_kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {"n_results": k_fetch}
745            if where_arg:
746                query_kwargs["where"] = where_arg
747            raw_res = self._base_retriever.query(query_texts=[query], **query_kwargs)
748            docs = raw_res.get("documents", [[]])[0]
749            metas = raw_res.get("metadatas", [[]])[0]
750            ids = raw_res.get("ids", [[]])[0]
751            for doc_id, doc_text, meta in zip(ids, docs, metas):
752                clean_meta = dict(meta or {})
753                roles_val = clean_meta.get(SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES)
754                if isinstance(roles_val, str) and roles_val:
755                    clean_meta[SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES] = [r.strip() for r in roles_val.split(",") if r.strip()]
756                req_roles = clean_meta.get(SEC_REQUIRED_ROLES)
757                if isinstance(req_roles, str) and req_roles:
758                    clean_meta[SEC_REQUIRED_ROLES] = [r.strip() for r in req_roles.split(",") if r.strip()]
759                candidates.append(SecureDocument.create(page_content=doc_text, metadata=clean_meta))
760        elif hasattr(self._base_retriever, "get_relevant_documents"):
761            candidates = self._base_retriever.get_relevant_documents(query, search_kwargs={"filter": push_down_filter, "k": k_fetch})
762        elif callable(self._base_retriever):
763            candidates = self._base_retriever(query, push_down_filter, k_fetch)
764
765        return self.prune_candidates(candidates, resolved_identity, top_k, config=config)

def build_full_ast( self, identity: Optional[langchain_security_extension.security_core.SecurityIdentity]) -> langchain_security_extension.security_adapter_langchain.retriever_wrapper.PrefilterAST: 
229    def build_full_ast(self, identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity]) -> PrefilterAST:
230        """Constructs unconstrained full AST from SecurityIdentity.
231
232        Args:
233            identity: Caller security identity or None for anonymous.
234
235        Returns:
236            PrefilterAST: Full prefilter AST dictionary.
237        """
238        if identity is None or identity.is_anonymous or identity.subject_id is None or str(identity.subject_id).upper() == ANONYMOUS_SUBJECT_ID:
239            return PrefilterAST({SEC_TENANT_ID: "__DENY_ALL_UNAUTHENTICATED__"})
240
241        and_clauses: List[Dict[str, Any]] = [
242            {SEC_TENANT_ID: identity.tenant_id},
243            {SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR: {"$lte": identity.clearance_level}},
244        ]
245
246        if identity.roles:
247            and_clauses.append({SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES: {"$in": list(identity.roles)}})
248
249        if identity.department_id:
250            and_clauses.append({
251                "$or": [
252                    {SEC_DEPARTMENT_ID: identity.department_id},
253                    {SEC_DEPARTMENT_ID: {"$exists": False}},
254                ]
255            })
256
257        return PrefilterAST({"$and": and_clauses})

Constructs unconstrained full AST from SecurityIdentity.

Args: identity: Caller security identity or None for anonymous.

Returns: PrefilterAST: Full prefilter AST dictionary.

def split_predicates( self, full_ast: Dict[str, Any], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]: 
259    def split_predicates(
260        self,
261        full_ast: Dict[str, Any],
262        *args: Any,
263        **kwargs: Any,
264    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]:
265        """Splits full AST into push-down filter and retained predicates based on store capability profile.
266
267        Args:
268            full_ast: Complete filter dictionary generated from SecurityIdentity.
269            *args: Optional positional store_profile string.
270            **kwargs: Optional keyword store_profile string.
271
272        Returns:
273            Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]: (push_down_filter, retained_predicates)
274        """
275        store_profile = str(kwargs.get("store_profile", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else self._store_profile))
276
277        if store_profile == STORE_PROFILE_NO_FILTER:
278            return PrefilterAST({}), dict(full_ast)
279
280        if store_profile == STORE_PROFILE_CONSTRAINED:
281            clauses = full_ast.get("$and", [full_ast]) if isinstance(full_ast, dict) else []
282            pushed_clauses: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
283            retained: Dict[str, Any] = {}
284
285            for clause in clauses:
286                if not isinstance(clause, dict):
287                    continue
288                for key, val in clause.items():
289                    if key == SEC_TENANT_ID:
290                        pushed_clauses.append({key: val})
291                    elif key == SEC_DEPARTMENT_ID and not isinstance(val, dict):
292                        pushed_clauses.append({key: val})
293                    else:
294                        retained[key] = val
295
296            if len(pushed_clauses) == 1:
297                push_down = pushed_clauses[0]
298            elif len(pushed_clauses) > 1:
299                push_down = {"$and": pushed_clauses}
300            else:
301                push_down = {}
302
303            return PrefilterAST(push_down), retained
304
305        return PrefilterAST(dict(full_ast)), {}

Splits full AST into push-down filter and retained predicates based on store capability profile.

Args: full_ast: Complete filter dictionary generated from SecurityIdentity. *args: Optional positional store_profile string. **kwargs: Optional keyword store_profile string.

Returns: Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Dict[str, Any]]: (push_down_filter, retained_predicates)

def build_prefilter_ast( self, identity: Optional[langchain_security_extension.security_core.SecurityIdentity], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]: 
307    def build_prefilter_ast(self, identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
308        """Translates caller identity envelope into dynamic VectorStore metadata filter AST dictionary according to store profile.
309
310        Args:
311            identity: Caller security identity or None for anonymous.
312            *args: Optional positional config dict.
313            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
314
315        Returns:
316            Dict[str, Any]: Prefilter AST dictionary envelope.
317        """
318        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
319        full_ast = self.build_full_ast(identity)
320        push_down, retained = self.split_predicates(full_ast)
321
322        if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
323            config["configurable"]["sec:vector_ast_prefilter"] = dict(push_down)
324            config["configurable"]["sec:retained_predicates"] = dict(retained)
325            config["configurable"]["sec:store_profile"] = self._store_profile
326
327        return PrefilterAST(push_down)

def prune_documents( self, documents: List[SecureDocument], identity: Optional[langchain_security_extension.security_core.SecurityIdentity], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> List[SecureDocument]: 
329    def prune_documents(
330        self,
331        documents: List[SecureDocument],
332        identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity],
333        *args: Any,
334        **kwargs: Any,
335    ) -> List[SecureDocument]:
336        """Post-retrieval pruning inspecting metadata on returned document chunks. Fail-closed if identity is None.
337
338        Args:
339            documents: Candidate list of SecureDocuments.
340            identity: Caller identity or None.
341            *args: Optional positional config dict.
342            **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.
343
344        Returns:
345            List[SecureDocument]: Filtered list of authorized SecureDocument objects.
346        """
347        config = kwargs.get("config", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else None)
348        resolved_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(identity)
349        pruned: List[SecureDocument] = []
350        audit_manager = getattr(self._pdp_engine, "audit_manager", None)
351
352        for doc in documents:
353            metadata = doc.metadata
354
355            # Optional HMAC Signature verification
356            if self._secret_key and SEC_ENVELOPE_HASH in metadata:
357                from langchain_security_extension.security_adapter_langchain.ingestion import compute_envelope_hmac
358                expected = compute_envelope_hmac(metadata, self._secret_key)
359                if metadata[SEC_ENVELOPE_HASH] != expected:
360                    if audit_manager:
361                        audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
362                            subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
363                            tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
364                            action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
365                            resource=str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
366                            decision="DENY",
367                            diagnostic_reason="POLICY_TAMPER_DETECTED | HMAC_MISMATCH: Envelope HMAC signature mismatch",
368                            severity=SEVERITY_CRITICAL_ALERT,
369                            metadata={"doc_metadata": metadata},
370                            enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
371                            reason_code=EVENT_POLICY_TAMPER_DETECTED,
372                        ))
373                    continue  # Fail-closed tampering detection
374                if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
375                    config["configurable"]["sec:envelope_verified"] = True
376
377            # Mandatory envelope verification: verify mandatory security envelope tags
378            doc_tenant = metadata.get(SEC_TENANT_ID)
379            has_tenant = bool(doc_tenant)
380            has_classification = bool(
381                metadata.get(SEC_CLASSIFICATION_LEVEL)
382                or metadata.get(SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR) is not None
383                or metadata.get("sec:clearance_level") is not None
384            )
385            if not (has_tenant and has_classification):
386                if audit_manager:
387                    audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
388                        subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
389                        tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
390                        action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
391                        resource=str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
392                        decision="PRUNED",
393                        diagnostic_reason="Missing mandatory security metadata: tenant_id or classification",
394                        severity=SEVERITY_NOTICE,
395                        metadata={"doc_metadata": metadata},
396                        enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
397                        reason_code=EVENT_RAG_UNAUTHORIZED_PRUNING,
398                    ))
399                continue
400
401            doc_clearance = int(metadata.get(SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR, metadata.get("sec:clearance_level", CLASSIFICATION_TO_RANK.get(str(metadata.get(SEC_CLASSIFICATION_LEVEL, "")).upper(), 0))))
402            doc_roles = metadata.get(SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES, metadata.get(SEC_REQUIRED_ROLES, []))
403            if isinstance(doc_roles, str):
404                doc_roles = [r.strip() for r in doc_roles.split(",") if r.strip()]
405            doc_quarantined = bool(metadata.get(SEC_QUARANTINED, False))
406
407            request = PolicyEvaluationRequest.create(
408                subject=resolved_identity,
409                action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
410                resource={
411                    "target_id": str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
412                    "tenant_id": doc_tenant,
413                    "min_clearance": doc_clearance,
414                    "required_roles": doc_roles,
415                    SEC_QUARANTINED: doc_quarantined,
416                },
417                context={"config": config} if config else {},
418            )
419
420            decision = self._pdp_engine.evaluate(request)
421            if decision.is_permitted:
422                pruned.append(doc)
423            else:
424                if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
425                    pruned_titles = config["configurable"].setdefault("sec:pruned_doc_titles", [])
426                    first_line = doc.page_content.splitlines()[0].lstrip("#").strip() if doc.page_content else ""
427                    if first_line and first_line not in pruned_titles:
428                        pruned_titles.append(first_line)
429                if audit_manager:
430                    audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
431                        subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
432                        tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
433                        action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
434                        resource=str(metadata.get("source", "document_chunk")),
435                        decision="PRUNED",
436                        diagnostic_reason=decision.diagnostic_reason,
437                        severity=SEVERITY_NOTICE,
438                        metadata={"doc_metadata": metadata},
439                        enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
440                        reason_code=EVENT_RAG_UNAUTHORIZED_PRUNING,
441                    ))
442
443        return pruned

Post-retrieval pruning inspecting metadata on returned document chunks. Fail-closed if identity is None.

Args: documents: Candidate list of SecureDocuments. identity: Caller identity or None. *args: Optional positional config dict. **kwargs: Optional keyword config dict.

Returns: List[SecureDocument]: Filtered list of authorized SecureDocument objects.

def prune_candidates( self, candidates: List[Any], identity: Optional[langchain_security_extension.security_core.SecurityIdentity], *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> List[Any]: 
445    def prune_candidates(
446        self,
447        candidates: List[Any],
448        identity: Optional[SecurityIdentity],
449        *args: Any,
450        **kwargs: Any,
451    ) -> List[Any]:
452        """Encapsulates candidate wrapping in SecureDocument, oversampling fetch sizing, AST evaluation, adaptive secondary paging, and returning original candidate objects.
453
454        Args:
455            candidates: Input raw candidates list.
456            identity: Caller security identity.
457            *args: Optional positional arguments (top_k, config).
458            **kwargs: Optional keyword arguments (top_k, config).
459
460        Returns:
461            List[Any]: Filtered list of up to top_k authorized candidate objects.
462        """
463        top_k = int(kwargs.get("top_k", args[0] if len(args) > 0 else DEFAULT_TOP_K_CANDIDATES))
464        config = kwargs.get("config", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
465
466        resolved_identity = IdentityBridge.resolve_identity(identity)
467        self.build_prefilter_ast(resolved_identity, config=config)
468
469        if not candidates:
470            return []
471
472        audit_manager = getattr(self._pdp_engine, "audit_manager", None)
473
474        raw_k_fetch = int(top_k * self._oversampling_factor)
475        k_fetch = min(max(raw_k_fetch, top_k), DEFAULT_MAX_FETCH_CAP)
476        if isinstance(config, dict) and isinstance(config.get("configurable"), dict):
477            config["configurable"]["sec:oversampled_fetch_k"] = k_fetch
478
479        sec_docs: List[SecureDocument] = []
480        doc_map: Dict[int, Any] = {}
481
482        # Filter by similarity score cutoff if score is present on candidate
483        filtered_candidates = []
484        for cand in candidates:
485            score = getattr(cand, "score", getattr(cand, "similarity_score", None))
486            if score is not None and self._similarity_cutoff > 0.0 and float(score) < self._similarity_cutoff:
487                continue
488            filtered_candidates.append(cand)
489
490        for cand in filtered_candidates:
491            if isinstance(cand, SecureDocument):
492                doc = cand
493            elif hasattr(cand, "page_content") and hasattr(cand, "metadata"):
494                doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=cand.page_content, metadata=cand.metadata)
495            elif hasattr(cand, "clearance_level") and hasattr(cand, "required_roles"):
496                meta = {
497                    SEC_TENANT_ID: getattr(cand, "tenant_id", resolved_identity.tenant_id),
498                    SEC_CLEARANCE_FLOOR: getattr(cand, "clearance_level", 0),
499                    SEC_ALLOWED_ROLES: getattr(cand, "required_roles", []),
500                    "source": getattr(cand, "source", ""),
501                }
502                if hasattr(cand, "quarantined"):
503                    meta[SEC_QUARANTINED] = getattr(cand, "quarantined")
504                if hasattr(cand, "envelope_hash"):
505                    meta[SEC_ENVELOPE_HASH] = getattr(cand, "envelope_hash")
506                doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=getattr(cand, "text", str(cand)), metadata=meta)
507            else:
508                meta = getattr(cand, "metadata", {})
509                content = getattr(cand, "page_content", getattr(cand, "text", str(cand)))
510                doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=content, metadata=meta)
511
512            sec_docs.append(doc)
513            doc_map[id(doc)] = cand
514
515        # First pass oversampled pruning
516        first_batch = sec_docs[:k_fetch]
517        pruned_sec_docs = self.prune_documents(first_batch, resolved_identity, config=config)
518
519        # Adaptive secondary paging fallback if post-pruning count < top_k
520        secondary_attempts = 0
521        current_offset = k_fetch
522        while len(pruned_sec_docs) < top_k and secondary_attempts < DEFAULT_MAX_SECONDARY_FETCHES:
523            if self._secondary_fetch_fn:
524                more_cands = self._secondary_fetch_fn(current_offset, k_fetch)
525                if not more_cands:
526                    break
527                more_sec_docs = []
528                for cand in more_cands:
529                    score = getattr(cand, "score", getattr(cand, "similarity_score", None))
530                    if score is not None and self._similarity_cutoff > 0.0 and float(score) < self._similarity_cutoff:
531                        continue
532                    if hasattr(cand, "page_content") and hasattr(cand, "metadata"):
533                        doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=cand.page_content, metadata=cand.metadata)
534                    else:
535                        doc = SecureDocument.create(page_content=str(cand), metadata=getattr(cand, "metadata", {}))
536                    more_sec_docs.append(doc)
537                    doc_map[id(doc)] = cand
538                sec_pruned = self.prune_documents(more_sec_docs, resolved_identity, config=config)
539                pruned_sec_docs.extend(sec_pruned)
540            elif current_offset < len(sec_docs):
541                next_batch = sec_docs[current_offset:current_offset + k_fetch]
542                if not next_batch:
543                    break
544                sec_pruned = self.prune_documents(next_batch, resolved_identity, config=config)
545                pruned_sec_docs.extend(sec_pruned)
546            else:
547                break
548            current_offset += k_fetch
549            secondary_attempts += 1
550
551        permitted_candidates = [doc_map[id(doc)] for doc in pruned_sec_docs if id(doc) in doc_map]
552
553        if len(permitted_candidates) < top_k and audit_manager:
554            audit_manager.record_event(AuditEvent.create(
555                subject_id=resolved_identity.subject_id,
556                tenant_id=resolved_identity.tenant_id,
557                action=ACTION_CHUNK_RETRIEVE,
558                resource="vector_retriever",
559                decision="STARVATION",
560                diagnostic_reason=f"Post-pruning candidate count ({len(permitted_candidates)}) < target top_k ({top_k})",
561                severity=SEVERITY_WARNING,
562                metadata={"requested_k": top_k, "returned_count": len(permitted_candidates)},
563                enforcement_point=PEP_RAG_FILTER,
564                reason_code=EVENT_RAG_RESULT_STARVATION,
565            ))
566
567        final_candidates = permitted_candidates[:top_k]
568        if get_pii_scope() == PII_SCOPE_FULL_IN_FLIGHT:
569            sanitizer = get_pii_sanitizer()
570            ctx = PiiContext.create(
571                PII_STAGE_RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT,
572                resolved_identity.tenant_id,
573                resolved_identity.subject_id,
574                "vector_retriever",
575                {"requested_k": top_k, "returned_count": len(final_candidates)},
576            )
577            for doc in final_candidates:
578                if hasattr(doc, "page_content") and isinstance(doc.page_content, str):
579                    doc.page_content = sanitizer.sanitize_text(doc.page_content, ctx)
580
581        return final_candidates

Returns: List[Any]: Filtered list of up to top_k authorized candidate objects.
